name: Frozen soft mask-aware local ToMe on DAVIS 2017 validation
status: Prospectively amended and frozen 2026-11-05 before any DAVIS validation inference; train engineering gate must pass.

scope.prompt: Ground-truth indexed mask on frame 0 for every object present in that frame; no later annotation is read by inference.
scope.interpretation: External to the PolypGen development cohort, but not asserted to be unseen by foundation-model pretraining. DAVIS val is exploratory transfer evidence, not a substitute for independent clinical data.

conditions.description: Unmodified SAM2 memory read and mask decoding.
Pinned upstream ToMe matching and weighted K/V merging within 4x4 windows; fixed 8 of 16 spatial keys merged per window.
Same ToMe implementation, window, and budget; matching metric combines appearance and continuous occupancy from the exact prediction passed to SAM2's memory writer.

method.read_location: Native SAM2 memory SDPA after native key/value projection and rotary position encoding.
method.merge: Use the frozen PolypGen protocol values: 4x4 spatial windows, 8 merges per 16 keys, role_weight 0.5, and attention log(cluster_size) mass correction.
method.multi_object: Use SAM2's native per-object propagation. Route each stored writer-mask occupancy map using the persistent object ID; never share occupancy across objects in the same frame.

pass_checks: Both persistent IDs receive only their own frame-0 writer-mask occupancy, matched by the exact SAM2 preflight resize.
Frame-1 propagation returns both original object IDs, finite logits, and unchanged output geometry.
Both ToMe conditions invoke all four native memory-attention layers once per object at frame 1.
Generic and mask-aware conditions use the same per-object, per-layer, per-frame, per-window key budget.
Spatial token mass is conserved; pointer keys and values are unchanged; SAM2 parameter digest is unchanged.
All predictions, receipts, and evaluator outputs are written beneath Google Drive outputs/experiment.

evaluation.primary: Official DAVIS 2017 J&F-Mean on val at 480p; report J and F components alongside it using the pinned davisvideochallenge evaluator.
evaluation.statistical_unit: video; average the official per-object J, F, and J&F values within each video before paired analysis. Preserve per-object rows descriptively.
evaluation.paired_inference: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests and 95% percentile bootstrap intervals over video-level J&F differences; 10,000 resamples, seed 20261105; Holm correction across the two primary local contrasts.
evaluation.dice: If reported, compute separately from framewise binary masks and label it supplementary. Do not equate Dice with DAVIS J&F or compare it directly with PolypGen Dice.
evaluation.comparison_policy: Published DAVIS results are context only: different checkpoints, backbones, training sets and inference implementations prevent treating them as paired controls. Re-run only the local native and matched generic controls.
evaluation.official_frame_policy: The pinned official semi-supervised evaluator removes frame 0 and the final frame from scoring (frames 1 through N-2 are scored). This behavior is verified in davis2017/evaluation.py and applies to every local condition.
evaluation.aggregation: Report the official global score (equal-weight mean across object-level temporal means) and per-object J/F. For primary paired inference, first average per-object J, F and J&F within each video, then treat the 30 videos equally.
evaluation.raw_precision: Use DAVISEvaluation.evaluate from the pinned official evaluator API; retain full precision in JSON/CSV. Do not read cached 3-decimal CSVs for statistical tests.
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: Resample the 30 paired video-level differences with replacement; do not resample objects or frames.

published_methods_without_davis_score.status: No DAVIS 2017 score was found in the paper's reported benchmark tables. Its official repository documents inference on DAVIS-style packed masks.

published_comparison_note: Published scores are context, not controlled arms: checkpoints, backbones, training data, precision and inference code differ. The SAM2 paper gives conventional VOS baselines and SAM2 scale variants; the original SAM2Long paper reports 90.2 for SAM2.1-L on DAVIS-17, while the later SeC comparison table reports SAM2.1Long at 91.4 and SAMURAI at 89.9. Keep those source-specific values distinct. Efficient-SAM2 provides directly relevant memory-retrieval and image-encoder merging comparisons. Lean-SAM2 code supports DAVIS-style inference, but its paper does not report a DAVIS score. The local paired conclusion is based only on native Hiera-Tiny, generic local ToMe, and soft-mask-aware local ToMe under one checkpoint, prompt setup, and evaluator.

amendments.scope: Literature comparator provenance only; no local DAVIS validation inference had started.
amendments.change: Added original-paper SAM2Long result separately from the SeC table's SAM2.1Long result, clarified SAM2 Hiera-Tiny's extra-data footnote, recorded that Lean-SAM2 supports DAVIS-style inference without reporting a DAVIS score, and linked SeC score rows to the authors' benchmark table while adding the official ICLR proceedings page to sources.
amendments.reason: Prevent source/protocol conflation and avoid inventing an unreported Lean-SAM2 DAVIS number.
